articles.headline: Pulisic racing against the clock
articles.description: Sam Borden says Christian Pulisic did not train with the team for the fourth straight day as the U.S. prepares without him.

articles.headline: Aguirre relishes Azteca knockout matches after Mexico win Group A
articles.description: Mexico beat South Korea 1-0 to become the first team to advance to the World Cup knockout stage, securing the top spot in Group A and a dream Round of 32 match at the Estadio Azteca.

articles.headline: Morocco's 'African Brazilians' gave Brazil a football lesson: Former assistant coach Patrice Beaumelle:
articles.description: Beaumelle said Morocco's showing against Brazil highlighted everything that makes the North Africans such a tantalising prospect.

articles.headline: Mexico beat South Korea at World Cup, but are still a work in progress
articles.description: Mexico still don't look like the finished product, but fine-tuning can wait for another day as the co-hosts punched their ticket to the round of 32.

articles.headline: Canada blows out Qatar for first-ever World Cup win
articles.description: Beth Lindop reports on Canada's impressive 6-nil win over nine-man Qatar for their first World Cup win.

articles.headline: Mexico edge South Korea, confirm progress to knockouts
articles.description: A Luis Romo goal saw Mexico beat South Korea 1-0
